意大利两大电子产品连锁店 Unieuro 和 MediaWorld 已落入外国人手中。
捷克亿万富翁 Daniel Kretinsky 赢得了对 Fnac Darty 的公开收购要约，现在控制其 69.3% 的股份。2024 年底，他曾共同出资帮助这家法国集团收购 Unieuro。

而 MediaWorld 则随着 JD.com 收购德国 Ceconomy，转到中国人手中。
Ceconomy 也是 Fnac Darty 的第二大股东，持股 21.9%，JD.com 通过它进入这家法国集团的资本。法国经济部长表示，他已收到保证，因为中方将保持少数股东身份，没有治理权。
与此同时，JD.com 通过 Joybuy 与 Fnac Darty 直接竞争，该网站于 3 月在法国推出。在中国，电商占零售业的 50%，在法国接近 13%。

那意大利人呢？和往常一样，只是在一旁看着。

JD.com ($JD) sold 13% more in 2025 and kept 93% less operating profit: RMB2.8 billion on RMB1.31 trillion of sales, against RMB38.7 billion a year earlier.

On 17 November it reported that the losses of its new businesses, food delivery above all, had narrowed sharply. The war with Meituan has not ended; it has become cheaper.

In 2025 JD made about RMB2 of operating profit on every RMB1,000 it sold. Its free cash flow, the cash left after paying for its investment, fell from RMB44.9 billion to RMB5.2 billion. The retail business was not the problem: JD's own results show its retail arm earning more, so the profit went into the new businesses.

The third quarter of 2026 shows the turn and its limit. JD earned RMB5.2 billion from operations, against a loss of RMB1.1 billion a year earlier. Its new businesses still lost RMB9.6 billion in those 3 months, more than 3 times what the whole group earned from operations in 2025.

So the question for investors is not whether JD can win orders. It is how long it keeps paying for them, and its results name no date for food delivery to break even.

JD.com ($JD) 在 2025 年销售额增长 13%，但营业利润减少 93%：销售额为人民币 1.31 万亿元，营业利润为人民币 28 亿元，而一年前为人民币 387 亿元。

11 月 17 日，它报告称其新业务的亏损已大幅收窄，其中尤其是外卖业务。与 Meituan 的战争尚未结束；只是成本变低了。

2025 年，JD 每卖出人民币 1,000 元，约获得人民币 2 元营业利润。其自由现金流，即支付投资后剩下的现金，从人民币 449 亿元降至人民币 52 亿元。零售业务并不是问题：JD 自己的业绩显示其零售部门赚得更多，因此利润流向了新业务。

2026 年第三季度显示出转向及其限度。JD 获得人民币 52 亿元营业利润，而一年前亏损人民币 11 亿元。其新业务在这 3 个月里仍亏损人民币 96 亿元，是整个集团 2025 年营业利润的 3 倍多。

因此，投资者的问题不是 JD 能否赢得订单。而是它还要为这些订单补贴多久，而且其业绩中没有给出外卖业务实现盈亏平衡的日期。

🚨 MICHAEL BURRY IS ALMOST ENTIRELY LONG. BUT HIS STOCK PICKS TELL A MUCH BIGGER STORY.
The legendary market bear is changing his playbook.
His biggest positions now include:
• MercadoLibre ($MELI)
• Temple & Webster ($TPW)
• JD.com ($JD)
His Hong Kong exposure has grown to over 20% of his portfolio:
• BYD
• Tencent
• Meituan
• Haidilao
• Haier

Here's what stands out:

1. he's moving away from broad market shorts.
Burry sold his remaining Nasdaq 100 ($NDX) puts and most of his Ero Copper ($ERO) position.
He's no longer aggressively betting against the entire market. He's becoming more selective.
2. he's not buying the AI hype blindly.
He still holds puts on Palantir ($PLTR), Nvidia ($NVDA) and MetLife ($MET).

That's a critical distinction: being bullish on the market doesn't mean being bullish on every stock.

3. he's diversifying across multiple sectors.

His other holdings include Adobe ($ADBE), Birkenstock ($BIRK), Deckers ($DECK), Molina Healthcare ($MOH), HCA Healthcare ($HCA), lululemon ($LULU), Fiserv ($FI), Veeva ($VEEV), PayPal ($PYPL) and Build-A-Bear ($BBW).

He also holds QXO preferred stock and long-dated calls on Sprouts Farmers Market ($SFM) and Zoetis ($ZTS).

He's increasing his long exposure without going all-in.

That tells me he's optimistic about opportunities, but still disciplined about valuations and downside risk.

my biggest takeaway:
the market has become obsessed with AI. But a great industry doesn't automatically make every stock a great investment.
Burry appears to be looking where the crowd isn't looking: international markets, overlooked businesses and better risk/reward opportunities.

On 17 November it reported that the losses of its new businesses, food delivery above all, had narrowed sharply. The war with Meituan has not ended; it has become cheaper.

In 2025 JD made about RMB2 of operating profit on every RMB1,000 it sold. Its free cash flow, the cash left after paying for its investment, fell from RMB44.9 billion to RMB5.2 billion. The retail business was not the problem: JD's own results show its retail arm earning more, so the profit went into the new businesses.

The third quarter of 2026 shows the turn and its limit. JD earned RMB5.2 billion from operations, against a loss of RMB1.1 billion a year earlier. Its new businesses still lost RMB9.6 billion in those 3 months, more than 3 times what the whole group earned from operations in 2025.

So the question for investors is not whether JD can win orders. It is how long it keeps paying for them, and its results name no date for food delivery to break even.

JD.com ($JD) 在 2025 年销售额增长 13%，但营业利润减少 93%：销售额为人民币 1.31 万亿元，营业利润为人民币 28 亿元，而一年前为人民币 387 亿元。

11 月 17 日，它报告称其新业务的亏损已大幅收窄，其中尤其是外卖业务。与 Meituan 的战争尚未结束；只是成本变低了。

2025 年，JD 每卖出人民币 1,000 元，约获得人民币 2 元营业利润。其自由现金流，即支付投资后剩下的现金，从人民币 449 亿元降至人民币 52 亿元。零售业务并不是问题：JD 自己的业绩显示其零售部门赚得更多，因此利润流向了新业务。

2026 年第三季度显示出转向及其限度。JD 获得人民币 52 亿元营业利润，而一年前亏损人民币 11 亿元。其新业务在这 3 个月里仍亏损人民币 96 亿元，是整个集团 2025 年营业利润的 3 倍多。

因此，投资者的问题不是 JD 能否赢得订单。而是它还要为这些订单补贴多久，而且其业绩中没有给出外卖业务实现盈亏平衡的日期。
